# Wendy Blumer Joins Alerus as Health and Welfare Sales Consultant


##### November 17, 2026


Alerus is pleased to announce Wendy Blumer has joined the company as a health and welfare sales consultant. In this role, she works with health insurance brokers, consultants, and employers to develop benefits programs tailored to their needs.


Wendy has more than 20 years of experience in employee benefits administration, specializing in pre-tax benefits and COBRA. She uses her expertise to help brokers and employers navigate complex requirements and identify solutions that support their employees and organizations.


Wendy holds a bachelor’s degree in liberal arts from the University of St. Thomas in St. Paul, Minnesota. She is based in the Twin Cities.
